description: Shared enemy body-plan direction. Identity and action-specific direction come from the biome enemy registry.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. Never import the referenced character's identity, anatomy, costume, or equipment.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body enemy reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is authoritative enemy identity. Preserve its recognizable head and face, anatomy cues, coloration, markings, and any identity-defining costume or equipment while translating the portrait into a complete side-facing-right battle silhouette. Image 2 is rendering-style authority only: use its crisp intentional pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm highlights, compact proportions, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps without importing its character design. Create exactly one {{name}}, a {{archetype}} enemy from the {{biome}} biome. Supporting identity traits: {{visualTraits}}. Biome art direction: {{biomeTraits}}. The silhouette must remain readable at 64x64. Use a {{background}} background, square canvas, generous padding, and no floor or scenery. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn complete {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{name}} enemy in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Identity traits: {{visualTraits}}. Existing action direction: {{actionDirection}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. {{motionDirection}} {{poseRequirement}} Preserve the exact accepted reference identity, anatomy, appendage and equipment count, palette, proportions, and right-facing orientation throughout. {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: Create a seamless living loop with breathing, weight, surface, or appendage motion appropriate to this creature.

attack.motionDirection: Show readable anticipation, windup, committed forward action, contact, follow-through, recoil, and recovery using the creature's actual body plan.
attack.effectRule: Any effect must remain compact and may not obscure anatomy or silhouette.

hit.motionDirection: Show a forceful articulated impact, maximum stagger or compression, displaced recovery, and return to readiness.
hit.effectRule: No gore, blood, full-body tint, or magical redesign.

death.motionDirection: Show defeat, loss of support, progressive collapse or dissolution, ground contact, settling, and an unmistakable final motionless rest pose.
death.effectRule: No gore or dismemberment. The final pose must be fully defeated and not a rotated upright sprite.

dead.prompt: Deterministically repeat the accepted terminal death frame eight times; never generate a separate corpse identity.
